name: Igeta
description: Well-curb crosses dyed into indigo cloth, the bars soft at their ends and each one a little out of register, like ikat-woven kasuri.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 26%; top: 12%; width: 48%; height: 76%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3)); -webkit-mask: @var(--bars); mask: @var(--bars); -webkit-mask-composite: source-in; mask-composite: intersect; -webkit-transform: rotate(0deg) translate(@r(-5%, 5%), @r(-4%, 4%)); transform: rotate(0deg) translate(@r(-5%, 5%), @r(-4%, 4%)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 26%; top: 12%; width: 48%; height: 76%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3)); -webkit-mask: @var(--bars); mask: @var(--bars); -webkit-mask-composite: source-in; mask-composite: intersect; -webkit-transform: rotate(90deg) translate(@r(-5%, 5%), @r(-4%, 4%)); transform: rotate(90deg) translate(@r(-5%, 5%), @r(-4%, 4%)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; --bars: linear-gradient(90deg, #000 0 22%, transparent 22% 78%, #000 78%), linear-gradient(180deg, transparent, #000 24% 76%, transparent); } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
